decks.notes: The deck focuses on utilizing a combination of powerful control spells and creatures to disrupt the opponent's game plan and protect its own win conditions. By leveraging counterspells, removal, card draw, and planeswalkers, the deck aims to outvalue and outlast the opponent, while also locking down the board with cards like Leyline Binding and Chalice of the Void. The inclusion of versatile cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Archmage's Charm allows for flexibility in different matchups, ensuring that the deck can adapt to various situations and emerge victorious.

The deck focuses on controlling the board and disrupting the opponent's game plan while also setting up powerful threats to quickly close out the game. It utilizes a mix of removal spells, planeswalkers, and powerful creatures to control the game's pace and outvalue the opponent. The deck aims to use efficient removal spells to deal with threats while gradually building up its own board presence and eventually overwhelming the opponent with powerful creatures and high-impact spells. It also utilizes a diverse manabase to ensure it can consistently cast its spells and adapt to different matchups.

The main concept of this deck is to aggressively control the board with efficient counterspells and removal while deploying threats like Murktide Regent, Dragon's Rage Channeler, and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer to quickly close out the game. The deck also utilizes card selection and graveyard manipulation to maximize its resources and maintain a consistent game plan. By combining aggressive creatures with disruptive spells, this UR Aggro deck aims to apply constant pressure on the opponent and maintain tempo throughout the match.

The main concept of the deck is to aggressively disrupt the opponent's game plan using discard spells like Thoughtseize and disruptive creatures like Dauthi Voidwalker and Grief. The deck aims to apply early pressure with aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Seasoned Pyromancer and finish off the opponent quickly with burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Fury. The deck also utilizes graveyard recursion with cards like Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger and Feign Death to outvalue the opponent and maintain a constant threat on the board.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize a landless combo strategy focused on casting spells to generate mana and manipulate the library, ultimately leading to a win condition with Goblin Charbelcher. With a mix of rituals, card draw, and spell manipulation, the deck aims to quickly assemble the pieces needed for a powerful Charbelcher activation to deal lethal damage to the opponent. The inclusion of various utility lands and spells allows for flexibility in game play and adaptation to different scenarios.

This deck revolves around using Indomitable Creativity and Transmogrify to cheat big creatures like Archon of Cruelty onto the battlefield quickly. The key strategy is to use Teferi, Time Raveler to protect your combo pieces and disrupt the opponent's plan. The deck also utilizes cards like Wrenn and Six for card advantage and Leyline Binding for additional control. The mana base is designed to support the deck's color requirements while also providing some flexibility. The goal is to assemble the combo pieces quickly and overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures.

The deck focuses on utilizing Underworld Breach along with a variety of low-cost spells and creatures to quickly assemble a game-winning combo. By filling the graveyard with spells using Mishra's Bauble and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, the deck can continuously cast spells from the graveyard using Underworld Breach to generate a powerful advantage. Additionally, cards like Teferi, Time Raveler provide disruption against opponents, while cards like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat offer removal and direct damage. The deck aims to efficiently cycle through its spells and resources to overwhelm the opponent with a lethal combo.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on a combination of hand disruption, efficient removal spells, and aggressive creatures to rapidly overwhelm the opponent. By combining cards like Thoughtseize, Dauthi Voidwalker, and Grief to disrupt the opponent's game plan, while deploying threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Seasoned Pyromancer to close out the game quickly, this deck aims to apply pressure early and often. With a mix of direct damage spells like Lightning Bolt and Terminate, along with recursion effects like Undying Malice and Feign Death, this deck is designed to be fast and relentless in its assault.

This deck focuses on quickly casting spells with Cascade, particularly violent outburst, to cheat out big creatures like crashing footfalls and murktide regent onto the battlefield for free. The deck also includes cards like force of negation and mystical dispute to protect its combo pieces and disrupt opponents. By leveraging the power of cascade and aggressive creatures, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with threats and disrupt their game plan for a fast and decisive victory.

The deck focuses on utilizing cards that generate tokens, such as Dwarven Mine, to fuel Indomitable Creativity, which allows the player to exchange those tokens for powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty. Teferi, Time Raveler and Wrenn and Six provide control and card advantage, while Fable of the Mirror-Breaker can be a game-ending combo piece. The deck also includes efficient removal and disruption spells like Lightning Bolt and Spell Pierce to protect the combo. The key strategy is to quickly assemble the combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats.

The deck focuses on using various cards to set up a powerful combo utilizing cards like Indomitable Creativity and Dwarven Mine to cheat out big threats like Archon of Cruelty. The deck also includes cards like Persist and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to further enhance the combo potential. The goal is to quickly assemble the combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with high-impact plays. The inclusion of cards like Inquisition of Kozilek and Lightning Bolt help disrupt the opponent's game plan while setting up the combo.  Overall, the deck aims to showcase a unique and creative way to win games in the Modern format.

This deck focuses on quickly playing creatures and dealing damage to the opponent's life total as fast as possible. By utilizing creatures with aggressive abilities and powerful spells like Lightning Bolt and Tribal Flames, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent before they have a chance to establish their own game plan. The inclusion of Jegantha as a companion adds an extra layer of consistency to the deck, ensuring that the player has access to a mana source whenever they need it. Overall, this deck is all about speed, aggression, and efficiency in attacking the opponent.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly assemble the combo pieces necessary to equip Colossus Hammer onto creatures like Ornithopter or Inkmoth Nexus, creating powerful threats that can quickly end the game. The deck uses cards like Stoneforge Mystic, Puresteel Paladin, and Sigarda's Aid to efficiently tutor and equip the Hammer, while cards like Giver of Runes and Spell Pierce provide protection for the key pieces. The inclusion of Urza's Saga allows for additional tutoring and flexibility in finding the necessary artifacts to win the game.

The deck focuses on a fast and aggressive playstyle, utilizing cheap spells to control the board while also dealing direct damage to the opponent. It includes a mix of counter spells, burn spells, and creatures with prowess abilities to pressure the opponent early on. The goal is to disrupt the opponent's game plan while maintaining a strong offense and finishing the game quickly with powerful threats like Murktide Regent and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer. The deck aims to be proactive, efficient, and versatile in order to secure victories in quick succession.

The deck focuses on assembling a powerful combo utilizing the Allosaurus Rider and Nourishing Shoal. By using Gemstone Mine and Serum Visions to set up the combo, the deck aims to cast Allosaurus Rider for free and exile it with Nourishing Shoal to gain a large amount of life. This life gain allows for the casting of big creatures like Autochthon Wurm, Worldspine Wurm, and Griselbrand. The deck also incorporates additional combo pieces such as Chancellor of the Tangle and Eldritch Evolution, as well as disruptive elements like Pact of Negation and Endurance.

The main idea of this deck is to quickly cascade into cards like Crashing Footfalls and Dead / Gone using cards like Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst. By utilizing cascade mechanics, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and disruptive spells. The deck also includes counterspells like Force of Negation and Mystical Dispute to protect its key combo pieces. Additionally, the deck features versatile cards like Brazen Borrower and Murktide Regent to provide flexibility in different situations. Overall, the deck focuses on quickly ramping into powerful plays to secure a victory.
